name: Looming Gait

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

---
You move in long and deliberate steps that take advantage of your height, and transfer that momentum to swing down at targets farther away. You Stride and then Strike. If you move half your Speed or less, this movement doesn't trigger reactions. If your weapon for that Strike doesn't have reach, it gains a reach of 10 feet for that Strike.
